answer: Make new identities pay a time-locked bond that vests only after a long horizon of good conduct, say 20 epochs, and slash it if graders catch collusion. A sybil farm then has to freeze capital in every fake account like seeds in frozen tundra, waiting with no yield. Graders can pull each thread of shared funding sources or synchronized timing between bonded accounts; one proven link forfeits every connected bond, so spawning thousands of clones multiplies risk instead of reward.
